rows.symptom: Non-persistent 2x2 test token center reports not inside N2 return mouth even as physical bounding box overlaps it and N2 observation Region.
rows.attempted_approach: Compared Foundry testInsideRegion and exact rectangular token-to-Region overlap in read-only R2 ephemeral spawn preview.
rows.failure_cause: Token-center approach is insufficient to detect full token footprint intersection with narrow station corridors.
rows.correction: Require full token bounding-box collision test before staging any automatic arrival; stage only 1x1 for R2 and send larger tokens to manual GM navigation.
rows.evidence_status: READONLY_REPRODUCED_AND_GUARD_RECORDED

rows.symptom: R3 N2 Tunnel B 2x2 center test missed a return-mouth footprint collision and overlap with story observation despite Wall crossing and token occupancy both clear.
rows.attempted_approach: Compared exact Region polygon rectangle to ephemeral token whole bounding box for 1x1 and 2x2 in live no-write Foundry scene.
rows.failure_cause: Center-only testInsideRegion is not sufficient for body-sized arrival and bounce avoidance when two triggered Regions border a narrow tunnel corridor.
rows.correction: Restrict initial R3 proposal to 1x1, require full token-footprint collision/owner state check in later guarded installer and preserve existing story/notice Regions; manual GM fallback for larger tokens.
rows.evidence_status: READONLY_REPRODUCED_GEOMETRY_GUARD_DOCUMENTED

rows.symptom: Frozen R1 source passed 38 syntax/static checks, but its alphabetical GM election ignores the authorized current Assistant Gamemaster and its prechecked arrival is recalculated during teleportToken.
rows.attempted_approach: Read exact immutable R1 staged source and inspect authorized GM identities, source API types, teleportTokens and teleportToken actual method implementations through authorized live read-only Foundry.
rows.failure_cause: Static string/hash checks are not contract semantics; source assumes first alphabetically sorted active GM is executor and does not bind preflight sample to actual destination choice.
rows.correction: Do not install frozen R1 v001. Introduce a reviewed new source version with explicit single authorized executor/lease, full-token-footprint eligibility, fixed or transaction-bound destination guarantee, no-bounce and outcome-unknown controls; run independent tests through a supported non-bypassing installer workflow.
rows.evidence_status: REPRODUCED_READONLY_SOURCE_SEMANTIC_BLOCKERS

rows.symptom: Legacy 38 static R1 checks passed without detecting unsafe GM election or independent commit placement, and whole-body collisions at N2 were invisible to center membership tests.
rows.attempted_approach: Documented exact endpoint fixture map from live read-only Foundry, built deterministic offline synthetic contract checks with 17 intentionally rejected unsafe inputs and immutable frozen source SHA checks.
rows.failure_cause: The earlier source verification checked selected strings and syntax rather than the negative-case semantics required for safe reciprocal travel.
rows.correction: Require one reviewed executor lease, real consent/ownership and source binding, one pinned actual-commit safe token-sized destination, no in-flight/unknown state, return mouth and puzzle Region avoidance. Preserve original staged scripts as known-bad evidence; do not promote before independently supported full runtime test.
rows.evidence_status: PASS_OFFLINE_TESTS_24_ZERO_LIVE_WRITES

rows.symptom: Previously staged R1 handler assumes preflight ephemeral sample and subsequent teleport will use the same safe landing, but documented placement/offset semantics do not guarantee pinned coordinates.
rows.attempted_approach: Compare center no offset, center with positive/negative offset, relative with/without offset, and random placement using exactly the same temporary Region and 1x1 Token at Foundry v14.367 with create:false; execute two repetitions per case.
rows.failure_cause: The documented offset is relative, center tests ignored the tested offsets, relative required offset and nevertheless returned two different locations for the same input. The teleport path recomputes destination separately.
rows.correction: Do not use offset as fixed absolute landing. Require independently reviewed fixed-coordinate transactional alternative with body-sized geometry, occupancy race, authority, client consent, recovery and GM/player canary, or use manual GM navigation.
rows.evidence_status: PASS_READONLY_OBSERVATION_NO_INSTALL

view_schemas.v_active_blockers:
CREATE VIEW v_active_blockers AS
SELECT item_id, item_class, title, problem, next_action, evidence_needed, priority, status, owner, source_id
FROM kb_open_items WHERE status IN ('open','in_progress','blocked') ORDER BY priority, item_id
view_schemas.v_project_plan:
CREATE VIEW v_project_plan AS
SELECT milestone_id, milestone, goal, deliverables, exit_gate, dependencies, status
FROM kb_milestones ORDER BY milestone_id
view_schemas.v_subject_readiness:
CREATE VIEW v_subject_readiness AS
SELECT subject_no, subject, status, depth, project_delta, community_research, next_step
FROM kb_research_subjects ORDER BY subject_no
